declared: before any candidate is scored on these axes; extends examples/algorithm-search/OBJECTIVES.json (be3ac745), whose contract, Pareto rule and wall-time tie rule still hold
ask: Chris 2026-11-20T10:45Z: find where any approach Pareto-dominates on semantic axes (visibility, work-saving, compositionality, etc.), weight that space so it is continuously searchable, implement and prove clear candidates only after empirical tests pass, all in the hypergraph, no benchmark gaming
rule_for_every_axis: an axis is admitted for selection only if, on every dev input, the do-nothing control scores 0 and the gamed control scores no higher than the best honest candidate; otherwise it is reported and marked UNMEASURED for selection

visibility.meaning: every result carries a witness on the hypergraph that an independent checker accepts
visibility.closure: valid witnesses / reference derived terms. A witness for term g is a record index w with: w <= the append at which g was emitted, record w admitted by the view, head(w) = g, and every premise of w emitted earlier by the same candidate
visibility.front: valid witnesses / reference non-front points at the final prefix. A witness for a non-front point is a current front member that dominates it
visibility.gamed: closure: witness = first record with that head, premises unchecked (counter with firsthead=on)
visibility.refutation: a candidate scoring 1 whose witness the checker rejects, or a witness accepted for a term the reference does not derive

work_saved.meaning: work avoided against cold recomputation, counted only when every prefix is correct
work_saved.closure: 1 - premise ops / premise ops of naive scratch recomputation (PR 7 closure.Scratch) on the same trace; 0 if any prefix is wrong
work_saved.front: 1 - dominance tests / dominance tests of cold sort-filter recomputation after every append; 0 if any prefix is wrong
work_saved.gamed: lookahead: handed the future, reports everything at the first append; wrong at that prefix, so 0
work_saved.note: for one family on one trace this is a monotone rescaling of ops; it adds the correctness gate and a common baseline across families
work_saved.refutation: a candidate with positive work_saved that is wrong at some prefix, or whose wall time exceeds the scratch baseline's

compositionality.meaning: two states built independently on two halves of a log merge into the state of the whole, reusing both
compositionality.closure: split each trace at its midpoint; correct_merge * (1 - merge ops / ops of the same engine over the whole trace from empty). correct_merge: the merged derived set equals the reference closure of the whole trace AND the merged state stays correct when the first 200 records are appended again
compositionality.front: split the run stream at its midpoint; correct * (1 - merge tests / tests of the same engine over the whole stream)
compositionality.selection: fraction of weight vectors on the denominator-10 grid for which pick(A u B) = pick({pick(A), pick(B)}), over 2 halves of each joint-plan front, for fixed versus data-normalized frames
compositionality.do_nothing: merge returns the left state: wrong, so 0
compositionality.gamed: merge = rebuild from empty over the whole log: correct but saves nothing, so 0
compositionality.refutation: a merged state that later diverges from the reference on a continued append

reversibility.meaning: the last append can be undone exactly, cheaper than rebuilding
reversibility.closure: at every 50th append k: append k, undo, the derived set must equal the reference set after k-1 appends, then re-append k and match the reference after k. Score = fraction undone exactly * (1 - mean undo ops / mean ops spent reaching k-1). Unsupported undo scores 0
reversibility.front: same at every 10th arrival against the exact front
reversibility.do_nothing: undo that does nothing is wrong whenever the append changed state, so it scores 0 unless no tested append changed anything (checked)
reversibility.gamed: snapshot before every append: correct, with the copy counted in the append ops axis
reversibility.prior_work: Bennett 1989 (reversible time/space trade-offs), Griewank and Walther 2000 (Revolve checkpointing), O'Callahan et al. 2017 (rr)
reversibility.refutation: an undo accepted here whose next append diverges from the reference

order_invariance.meaning: the answer and the work do not depend on arrival order
order_invariance.closure_front: on the reversed order and three fixed-seed shuffles of each dev trace: all final answers correct * (1 - (max ops - min ops) / mean ops)
order_invariance.gamed: none constructed beyond lookahead (wrong at prefixes)
order_invariance.refutation: two orders with different correct answers

robustness.meaning: correct on adversarial variants of the dev traces
robustness.closure: fraction of {dup-records, dup-premises, filtered} variants of each dev trace answered correctly at every prefix
robustness.front: fraction of {duplicated points, all-equal points, Chris's (0,4),(4,0),(3,3)} answered exactly
robustness.refutation: a pass on a variant the reference disagrees with

families_covered.b2_joint: compositionality of the fold over factor blocks
families_covered.b3_e_selection: compositionality of picks under fixed versus data-normalized frames
families_covered.c_stop: visibility is the certified flag already measured in PR 7; no new axis
families_covered.f_binding: UNMEASURED on every axis: no compiler-resolved bindings exist here to check a witness against

unmeasured_by_design: any axis named by Chris with 'etc.' that has no operational measure here: e.g. semantic coherence, intent fidelity, generality to pages not written for the test

data.dev: estate, v2 (closure); idol-eyes campaigns 1-4 (fronts, joint plans, selection)
data.heldout: refs, v2-rr (closure); campaigns 5-6, built or opened only after the dev down-select record

current_approach: PR 7 survivors: counter worklist, watched-premise closure, online archive, cold sort-filter, pruned fold, solved Chebyshev weights

amendments_after_smoke_run.when: after one single-repeat smoke run of every candidate, before the contract run; disclosed in CLAIMS.md
amendments_after_smoke_run.why: the smoke run showed three axes could be raised by padding work: each divided by the candidate's own cost, so a slower engine scored higher
amendments_after_smoke_run.compositionality: merge cost is now divided by a common baseline: one naive fixpoint over the whole log (closure) or one sort-filter over the whole stream (front)
amendments_after_smoke_run.reversibility: undo cost is now divided by a common baseline: the plain counter's ops to reach k-1 (closure) or one sort-filter of the prefix (front)
amendments_after_smoke_run.order_invariance: spread is now (max ops - min ops) / the cold-recompute baseline of the forward order, not / the candidate's own mean
amendments_after_smoke_run.visibility: added a second gamed control, lastwitness (witness = the record just appended), because firsthead coincides with the true witness when every head has one record
